_comment: Gathm's tools-and-skills catalog. Generated by catalog/build.py from catalog/tools/ and catalog/sources.json; do not edit by hand. Users install from it; nothing here ships with the product. Every file is pinned by SHA-256; relative URLs resolve against this index.

dependencies._comment: How to install a system binary a tool needs. 'package' names the package for the local package manager (a string for every platform, or a map keyed darwin/linux/termux/windows). 'go' is a Go module path for 'go install'. 'pipx' is a PyPI application. 'advice' alone means Gathm cannot install it; the text tells the user what to do.

naabu.note: naabu needs libpcap headers to build: brew install libpcap on macOS, apt-get install libpcap-dev on Debian/Ubuntu.

strix.advice: strix is a local binary Gathm wraps. Put it on PATH or set GATHM_STRIX_BIN.

maltego.advice: Install Maltego from https://maltego.com and put its launcher on PATH.
